command:
set -eu
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'service_enabled='; systemctl is-enabled loopback-web.service
printf 'service_active='; systemctl is-active loopback-web.service
printf 'listener\n'; ss -ltnp 'sport = :8081'
loopback_body=$(curl --noproxy '*' --fail --silent --show-error --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:8081/)
printf 'loopback_http_body=%s\n' "$loopback_body"
set +e
external_output=$(curl --noproxy '*' --silent --show-error --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 5 "http://$NODE_IP:8081/" 2>&1)
external_rc=$?
set -e
printf 'external_target=%s:8081 external_curl_rc=%s\n' "$NODE_IP" "$external_rc"
printf 'external_result=%s\n' "$external_output"
if [ "$external_rc" -eq 0 ]; then
  printf 'ERROR: external address unexpectedly reached service\n' >&2

fi
